#183 · Aqua Mouse Pokémon

Marill

Water Fairy

Johto · Generation 2

Marill is a Water/Fairy-type Aqua Mouse Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 8.5 kg. It evolves from Azurill and into Azumarill. Its highest base stat is HP (70), with a base stat total of 250.
